Fresno I-693 medical exam cost: published fees and questions to ask

For an immigration medical examination in Fresno, the key question is the full price for the services you individually need, not just the advertised examination fee. AFC Urgent Care Fresno lists a $750 base examination fee and separate charges for several laboratory tests and vaccines. Always ask for a current, itemized quote and verify the designated civil surgeon.

What the advertised $750 covers

AFC Urgent Care Fresno advertises a $750 base immigration medical examination for adults and children. The clinic publishes additional testing and vaccine charges separately. Treat the amount as one clinic's advertised examination fee, not the total for every applicant, a market average, or a guaranteed quote.

Itemized tests and vaccines

The Fresno clinic lists RPR syphilis testing at $46, gonorrhea testing at $90, QuantiFERON tuberculosis testing at $100, and an indicated chest X-ray at $90. Published vaccine prices include Tdap $65, MMR $110 and seasonal influenza $45. Which tests or vaccines are needed depends on the applicant and current clinical and immigration requirements; simply adding everything would mislead readers.

How many visits are needed?

The practice describes at least two visits for the immigration medical examination. The follow-up commonly occurs after laboratory results have returned. Confirm the appointment timetable with the office before travel, because processing time and available appointments can change.

Confirming a designated civil surgeon

Before paying, check the specific physician using the official USCIS Find a Civil Surgeon tool. A clinic advertising I-693 services does not independently prove every physician at that address is currently designated. Ask who will perform and sign the form, and what happens if that clinician is unavailable.

Documents and questions

Bring a valid identity document, available immunization records and relevant medical records, and follow the latest USCIS Form I-693 instructions. Ask for an itemized written estimate that distinguishes the exam, laboratory tests, vaccines or titers, X-rays, follow-up visits and copies. Ask when the required completed paperwork will be delivered and whether extra charges apply.

Comparing Fresno and Clovis offices

Compare clinics on the same examination scope, verified civil-surgeon identity, written fees, expected paperwork turnaround and accessibility. A limited examination quote is not interchangeable with a bundled laboratory and vaccination quote. This page describes one practice with a directly published price; it does not rank all local civil surgeons or claim that this is the lowest offer.

Editorial independence

This guide is independent information, not medical or immigration legal advice. No clinic mentioned is verified as an advertiser, contracted referral recipient or guaranteed appointment provider. Fees, clinic policies, designation and vaccination guidance can change. Confirm directly with the clinic and the appropriate official government service.
